evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: Content coordinates and an origin/processing condition are explicitly bound for candidate entries.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit origin/organization entry, and the separation of content vs origin/status are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing/origin condition (command_estimate) is explicitly linked to the same content coordinates for a candidate item.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content (colour attributes with coordinate sets) for current and candidate referents.

D.rationale: For multiple referents the report presents content coordinates separately from origin/representation-status metadata, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Entries include explicit organization/access descriptors (origin kinds, represented_time, inherited_current) describing how content is represented or accessed.
